subject: Popup to notify shiny job is complete while working on other tasks?

messages.author: 98d2aca11b7eab89
messages.subject: Popup to notify shiny job is complete while working on other tasks?
parts:
While trying to automate different long computational results, the users will have to come back to shiny app the check if the job is complete using the progress bars now. 

is it possible to somehow notify the user using a pop up or something after the job is complete so that the users can submit the job and work on something else?

I tried looking at some options in shinyBS but am not sure if i can use them.

Thanks.

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Popup to notify shiny job is complete while working on other tasks?
parts:
I happen to create a such kind of shiny-app. 

The idea is: 

1. include this line to your ui.R
 HTML('<input id="warnMsg" type="text" style="display:none;" value="" class="shiny-bound-input" onchange="genWarnMsg()">'))

2. when your long computational progress finished, update above input, using updateTextInput

3. include JavaScript: 
function genWarnMsg() {
  if ($("#warnMsg").val() != "") {
    alert($("#warnMsg").val())
  }
}


Good luck!
